text:
sam_infra: Heads-up — DC1 (edge-pop) cluster bring-up targeted for next Tue. We need to lock GPU quota/reservation and a pre-warm window. Provider quota pool for that region is tiny right now. Who can own the quota request + quick cost estimate? cc @lili_netops @mira_sre

devon_oncall: I can take the quota request. Need exact SKU, start/end window, and estimate of simultaneous pods/instances. Also any hard constraints on node sizing?

lili_netops: Network FYI: DC1 doesn't yet have our shared-VPC peering in place — that will add ~30-45m of setup plus NAT gateway provisioning. Egress capacity is also limited; might need an extra NAT/egress IP. Infra, pls confirm VPC attachment plan so I can include it in the provider ticket.

mira_sre: For the GPU reservation flow I recommend: 1) file quota request with justification 2) create a sticky reservation (7d) with burst slots 3) run priming job to pull model weights + populate KV cache 4) smoke tests (latency, throughput, model correctness). Minimal quota request payload below to copy into provider portal: 

mira_sre: ```
resource: 'gpu-v100'
region: 'dc1'
count: 16
start: '2024-07-02T02:00Z'
end: '2024-07-09T02:00Z'
purpose: 'cluster bring-up priming'
notes: 'Priming for Redwood inference cluster: pre-download models, run unit smoke tests'
```

devon_oncall: Cost rough calc: ~$2.70/hr per GPU (vendor estimate) => 16 GPUs ~= $43.2/hr => ~$1k/day if we keep 24h. I'll run actual pricing matrix for DC1 and post a short PR to the budget repo with options (reserved vs on-demand).

sam_infra: We also need the priming container + the batch script to load weights and run a few inference passes. @mira_sre can you own priming job + logs?

mira_sre: Yep, I'll build a small priming image that pulls our top-3 models, runs a 1k-token generation across each, and uploads priming logs to S3. I'll add a short smoke checklist to the runbook: 
- node ping/pod scheduling
- NVidia driver + CUDA check
- model init time < target
- sample generations pass golden prompts
- route fallback works

lili_netops: Opened NET-457: VPC peering + NAT + route table changes. ETA end of day tomorrow to get peering in staging. Adding required firewall rules for healthchecks. :white_check_mark:

devon_oncall: Filed quota ticket Q-789 with provider support, referenced NET-457 and included the payload Mira posted. Provider asked for traffic diagrams and expected egress — uploaded a quick diagram and rough numbers to the support ticket. Will update when they ack.

sam_infra: Solid. Let's set a quick handoff call Friday 10am PT to lock timings and rollback plan. I'll send calendar invite. Owners: devon (quota + cost), lili (network), mira (priming/tests), sam (bring-up PM).

mira_sre: :thumbsup: I'll document the priming runbooks and attach job manifests to the runbook repo before the call.

deploy-bot: Meeting created: "DC1 edge bring-up - quota & priming handoff" Fri 10:00 PT. Participants: devon_oncall, lili_netops, mira_sre, sam_infra.

sam_infra: Thanks everyone — we'll reconvene on Friday and cut the reservation once provider confirms quota.
